signals.headline: PPC Agrees to Sell EDP to Platinum Equity
signals.summary: Chicago (Oct. 28, 2026) — PPC agrees to sell EDP to Platinum Equity under a definitive agreement. PPC is a family-oriented investment firm that partners with family-, founder- and management-owned businesses, while EDP is a leading provider of propane distribution services.
